cooked: One distinction worth making in the verification plan is that libbitcoinkernel is a compatibility oracle, but not an independent consensus implementation: it shares code with Bitcoin Core. Agreement with it can catch integration errors in bitcoin-rs, while agreement with another implementation or carefully specified test vectors provides a different kind of evidence. Recording minimized differential failures as permanent regression cases would make that distinction useful over time.
